title: Take One source record
description: Structural rules for one licensed source in sources.json. NOTE: this schema enforces STRUCTURE only. Semantic rules -- rejecting uploader-asserted verification, detecting stale next_review_date, cross-record duplicate detection -- are enforced Python-side in scripts/preflight.py because JSON Schema cannot express 'date is in the past' or 'unique across the document'.

source_id.description: Lowercase, digits, underscores only. Unique across sources.json (uniqueness checked in preflight, not here).

files.description: Exact filenames this record covers. Matched exactly -- no substring, no fuzzy matching.

audio_license.description: Audio is a SEPARATE license from video. Silent films are often rescored and the score may still be under copyright.

verified_by.description: A named human or institution. Values of uploader/ia/internet_archive/unknown are REJECTED by preflight -- IA 'PD' tags are uploader-asserted, not verified.

verification_method_detail.description: REQUIRED by preflight when verification_method is 'other'.

next_review_date.description: US PD cutoff is 95 years after publication and moves every Jan 1. This date is authoritative; preflight fails if it is in the past.

consent_status.description: Consent is separate from copyright. Commissioned capture needs model releases, not just object masking.

risk_flags.description: These SURFACE known gaps in logs. They do not clear them. See Known Gaps in CLAUDE.md.
